decisions.reason: Turnaround management software draws directly on the firm's docking, apron and gate know-how and installed sensor base, so the firm can read early results and improve the product; its consistent dedicated page signals continued commitment.

The apron connectivity module builds on the firm's integration expertise and installed equipment, and moving from a mention to a dedicated page in 2024 shows it is being assimilated into the digital apron portfolio.

Revenue and billing software is further from the firm's core engineering knowledge, but it uses operational data the firm already captures and was promoted to its own page in 2024, so it is kept while learning continues.

Monitoring apron equipment builds directly on the firm's maintenance and installed-base experience, giving it strong ability to interpret the results and refine the product, and its 2024 upgrade to a dedicated page shows growing commitment.
